rules: Twenty-three measured exhibits sit on 52 regions - twelve plates and eleven grids - and five further exhibits (Table 1, Table 3, Table 11, Table 15, Figure 11) have no measured region at all, so the census of this paper is 28 exhibits read against 23 boxed rows [place.area_frac]

Nodes-and-arrows and process diagrams carry the whole visual argument: four flowcharts, three node-link networks, two line plates, one composite panel and two plates that fit no family - not one bar chart, histogram or box plot on the paper [geometry.family]

The exhibit type tracks the model, not the page: the network plates fall in Model 1 (3.2, 3.3), the PCA grids in 4.1-4.4, the SPN grids in 5.1-5.3, and every process schematic opens the section it belongs to [place.section_path]
Keys are mostly absent: six plates print no key at all, three print one inside the drawing, two print one below, and only the treemap puts its key outside at the right [geometry.legend]
Only three of twelve plates print readable numbers on their marks - the scree plot, the treemap and the bar half of Figure 9 - so most plates can only be ranked, not read [geometry.printed_numbers]
Nothing measured is drawn in depth: all twelve plates record three_d no, and the paper’s one surface mesh is Figure 11, the exhibit the measurer never boxed [geometry.three_d]
Every measured grid is booktabs - horizontal rules only, no vertical rule and no zebra striping in eleven grids [table.rule_style]
Every measured grid fills the text column and every one is portrait; not a single landscape or narrow-column grid on the paper [table.width]
Merged cells appear only where one stub answers a block of rows: Table 2’s four category groups, Table 5’s three concern blocks and Table 7’s two-line header [table.merged_cells]
Three grids carry a continuation, and in every case the tail is a separate measured region with neither header nor stub repeated across the break [table.continued]
Only three of eleven grids align their decimals - Table 6, Table 7 and Table 12 - and Table 13 mixes 0.255 with 0.0418 in one column [table.decimal_aligned]

Caption side is not uniform: thirteen captions print ABOVE their exhibit and ten below, and the split runs between the media - nine of eleven grids are headed by their caption while six of twelve plates are followed by theirs [caption.position]
Captions are noun phrases of five to fifteen words, twenty-two of them captioned at one or two sentences, and not one names a unit, a variable, a condition or a conclusion [caption.words]

Every pointer abbreviates - Fig. N or Table N - while every caption prints the full word, and all seventeen pointed rows use the same locative clause; six rows are never pointed at [mention.lead_pattern]

Four exhibits are announced on a page other than the one they print on: three a page early and Table 13 two pages late, its only numbered pointer sitting in the sensitivity section [mention.first_page]

Six rows are never named in prose - three plates and three grids, including both SPN twins and the uncaptioned Monte Carlo grid - so a quarter of the exhibits reach the reader with no introducing sentence [mention.count]
